root_cause: The original v0.1 Kyunghyang 2005 politics10 identity audit incorrectly classified 김근태 and 손학규 as new canonical people even though both already existed in NewsMaker 2003 politics Top10. The old builder therefore asserted 195 unique people and failed before materialization.

superseded_expectation.reason: person novelty was confused with placement novelty for 김근태 and 손학규

guardrail: A newly added placement does not create a new canonical person when the same person already exists in an earlier cohort.
